user.title: Choose connection mode
user.description: Choose how to connect to your Arctic Spas hot tub.

data_description.mode: REST requires only an API key (recommended). MQTT provides real-time updates and power monitoring but requires your My Arctic Spa username and password. Local requires your spa's IP address and needs no internet connection.

rest.title: REST API (Cloud)
rest.description: Enter your My Arctic Spa API key. Generate one at [{api_key_url}]({api_key_url})

mqtt.title: Cloud MQTT
mqtt.description: Enter your My Arctic Spa app credentials. Your password is hashed before storage — plaintext is never saved.

local.title: Local (no internet)
local.description: Enter your spa's local IP address. Connects directly to the spa over your local network — no cloud dependency.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to spa. Check your network and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Please check and try again.
error.port_not_open: Cannot reach the spa on the specified port. Ensure the spa is reachable on your local network.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Arctic Spas hot tub is already configured.
